purpose: Ecosystem-wide, deduplicated Splunkbase vendor/product/TA coverage universe with strictly separated count dimensions (Universal Vendor Coverage Mandate).

discovery_coverage.scope: Pinned public Splunkbase list API snapshot on 2026-10-26
discovery_coverage.limitations: Complete only against the declared snapshot denominator; not an exhaustive global vendor/product inventory. Private, removed, unlisted and non-Splunkbase integrations excluded. Curated first-match lexicon and title-derived product candidates require review; Splunk-published vendor integrations can fall in the platform bucket.

methodology.publisher_not_vendor: Publisher (display_author) names are counted as publishers only. Technology vendors are recognized through the curated vendor lexicon applied against app title + appid; consultancy/partner publishers remain publishers and are never promoted to vendors.
methodology.not_all_apps_produce_telemetry: Directory listings and utility apps are counted in the universe but are explicitly excluded from telemetry-coverage claims.
canonical_link_rules: canonical vendor alias in title/appid (word-boundary match, longest alias first)

provenance.fetch_scope: Public Splunkbase metadata API only; no app packages downloaded, no TA installed, no Splunk config changes.
